name: text-embedding-v4
description: qwen3-rerank is a text reranker model on Alibaba Cloud Bailian. Paired with an embedding model, it significantly improves retrieval accuracy across 100+ mainstream languages. Each request can process up to 500 documents (≤4K tokens each), making it a common component for RAG and semantic search workflows. It replaces the deprecating gte-rerank.
zhDescription: qwen3-rerank 是阿里云百炼上的文本重排序模型，配合 Embedding 可显著提升检索精度，支持 100+ 主流语种；单次请求最多处理 500 个文档，每条最长 4K tokens，是 RAG 与语义检索的常用组件，替代将于 2026-05-30 下线的 gte-rerank。
longDescription: qwen3-rerank is a text reranker model on Alibaba Cloud Bailian. Paired with an embedding model, it significantly improves retrieval accuracy across 100+ mainstream languages. Each request can process up to 500 documents (≤4K tokens each), making it a common component for RAG and semantic search workflows. It replaces the deprecating gte-rerank.
